suno.estilo: Victory fanfare and results screen: relief and quiet pride, warm. Melancholic acoustic chamber folk for a dark fantasy game. Recorded live in a small stone chapel: natural medium reverb, warm close mics, organic human timing. Core ensemble: nylon-string guitar, lute, psaltery, low cello, wooden flute, small metal bells, singing bowls. A bright 2-bar flourish of strummed guitar and bells ending on D major, then a calm lilting loop: lute melody, soft low cello, flute, light tambourine. Stays in D major throughout, strict steady 96 BPM, 4/4. Form: 2-bar fanfare, 8-bar calm loop, gentle ending.
